title: Entry points
subtitle: Which ads, flyers and buttons bring people to your WhatsApp
forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view entry points.
saveForbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.

list.emptyDescription: Give each ad, flyer or website button its own WhatsApp link. When someone messages through it, you'll see where they came from here, and their contact gets a tag.
list.name: Name
list.creditNote: Opted in and booked count people who did so within 30 days of arriving, credited to the last entry point they came through. People who delete the code from their message aren't counted.

form.description: People who message through this link are counted here and tagged.
form.name: Name
form.codeRule: 3 to 12 letters and digits, with at least one of each.
form.codeFixed: The code can't change. Create a new entry point for a new code.
form.numberHelp: With the country code, for example 61 400 000 000.
form.defaultText: Hi! I'd like to know more [{code}]
form.needsCode: The message must contain the code {code}.

detail.link: WhatsApp link: put it on your website, in a QR code or behind a button.
detail.text: Pre-filled message: for a Facebook or Instagram click-to-WhatsApp ad, paste this into the ad's pre-filled message.
detail.textHelp: Keep the code in the message: that's how Weline knows where people came from.
detail.noArrivalsDescription: When someone sends the message with this code, they'll appear here.
detail.archiveDescription: Messages with {code} won't be counted any more. Its history stays, and the code can't be used again.
detail.deleteDescription: Nobody has arrived through it, so it's removed completely and the code is free again.
